decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on leveraging the Companion ability of Jegantha, the Wellspring to maximize its aggressive strategy. The deck aims to quickly deploy threats like Agatha's Soul Cauldron, Voldaren Thrillseeker, and Tree of Perdition to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The inclusion of cards like Inti, Seneschal of the Sun and Voldaren Epicure provides additional utility and versatility to ensure victory in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using a variety of spells and creatures to disrupt your opponent's strategy while searching for key cards with Bring to Light. Niv-Mizzet Reborn serves as the centerpiece of the deck, allowing you to draw cards and gain value whenever you cast it. The addition of powerful planeswalkers like Omnath, Locus of Creation and powerful removal spells like Vanishing Verse helps you maintain control of the game. Yorion, Sky Nomad also provides additional value by flickering permanents for extra card advantage and protection.

The key concept of this deck is to efficiently utilize spells and instants to fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes and then bring them back for quick and consistent damage. By utilizing cards like Ledger Shredder, Sleight of Hand, and Treasure Cruise to fill the graveyard, combined with cheap spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to trigger Arclight Phoenix's ability, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast and aggressive plays. With a focus on spell recursion and a balance of card draw and removal, this deck seeks to maintain tempo and pressure throughout the game.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. It aims to apply pressure early on with cheap creatures like Dusk Legion Zealot and Vein Ripper, backed up by powerful finishers like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The inclusion of cards like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat ensures that the deck can handle opposing threats efficiently. The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize, utilizing the synergy between creatures and spells to secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressively ramping up mana using green devotion cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Leyline of the Guildpact to quickly cast powerful threats such as Cavalier of Thorns and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines. The deck also includes cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival to generate card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. With a strong mana base and efficient creatures, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats early in the game.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disruptive plays with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also utilizes graveyard synergies with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The mana base includes a mix of fast lands, shock lands, and creature lands to ensure consistent mana production. The overall strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a strong board presence to quickly close out the game.

The deck aims to quickly assemble a combo using Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creature threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier or Ob Nixilis, the Adversary. It also disrupts the opponent's hand with discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, while controlling the board with removal like Fatal Push and Torch the Tower. The deck also utilizes Case of the Stashed Skeleton to recycle key combo pieces and generate card advantage. Overall, the deck is focused on efficiently executing its combo game plan while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes a companion creature, Kaheera, the Orphanguard, to provide additional support and synergy with the deck's creatures. The deck aims to outlast opponents through board wipes like Supreme Verdict and by generating card advantage with cards like Memory Deluge. The lands in the deck are designed to support the control strategy, including utility lands like Castle Vantress and Field of Ruin.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get Arclight Phoenix into play to deal damage to the opponent. The deck utilizes cards like Opt, Sleight of Hand, and Consider to filter through the deck and find the Phoenix. Additionally, there are cards like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to control the board and protect the Phoenix once it is in play. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana and flexibility to the deck. Overall, this deck aims to be fast-paced and aggressive in its strategy.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent with low-cost, aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage, backed up by burn spells like Lightning Helix and Boros Charm. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace by utilizing cards like Light Up the Stage for card advantage and Slickshot Show-Off for additional damage. With a mix of direct damage spells and efficient creatures, this deck seeks to overwhelm opponents early on and secure a victory before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence of spirit creatures while disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal. Its key strength lies in its ability to control the tempo of the game by efficiently utilizing its creatures' abilities and protecting them with counterspells. The deck aims to establish early dominance on the battlefield and maintain pressure on the opponent through efficient card advantage and disruption. It excels at closing out games quickly and efficiently, overwhelming opponents before they can stabilize.

The deck revolves around generating life gain and utilizing creatures with enter the battlefield triggers to create a powerful combo with Amalia Benavides Aguirre. By gaining life, the deck can quickly build up to utilize Aetherflux Reservoir as a win condition. The deck also includes various creatures and spells to support the combo and protect key pieces. The strategy focuses on setting up the combo efficiently while controlling the board with a mix of creatures and spells to stay ahead of the opponent.

The main idea behind this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By using cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Vein Ripper, and Archfiend of the Dross, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Duress, and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord, the deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and hinder their ability to respond effectively. With a mix of direct damage, creature removal, and creature pump spells, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo utilizing cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre, Chord of Calling, Return to the Ranks, and Collected Company to generate value, gain life, and create a strong board presence. The strategy revolves around utilizing creatures with enter-the-battlefield effects and life gain triggers to gain incremental advantage and overwhelm opponents. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Skyclave Apparition and Extraction Specialist to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and assemble its combo pieces to secure victory.

The deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing cards like Vein Ripper and Bloodtithe Harvester to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes control elements such as Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck includes powerful finishers like Archfiend of the Dross and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the aggressive game plan, with cards like Mutavault and Blackcleave Cliffs providing additional utility. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. By combining creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to apply pressure while controlling the board. Additionally, cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value and synergy with the deck's other cards. Overall, the strategy of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to maintain a fast pace and keep opponents on their heels with a mix of threats and disruption.
